column1: # What iFlytek and SenseTime said about chip supply in their own results documents, offering documents, investor records and exchange answers, Jan 2025 to Nov 2026. Same columns as tables/labs_said.tsv: company; date said (from the page); event; speaker and title as the page gives them (iFlytek's activity records list who attended but do not say who gave each answer); source kind; exact words (|| joins separate passages of the same page); saved id under research/primary; cut = FOR / AGAINST / CONTEXT relative to the position that Beijing's policy pulled against what the companies wanted (the project's reading); note. Every passage was checked against its saved copy by script.

column3: event
column7: exact_words
column10: note

column3: Investor relations activity record (filed on cninfo)
column5: Director, vice president, board secretary (the only company attendee listed)
column7: 因为只能使用国产算力，我们额外花费 2 个月完成华为昇腾 910B 算力的适配和优化 || 和 DeepSeek 直接使用 英伟达 H800 卡上开展的各种工程优化不同，科大讯飞选择了更难的全国产算力 路线
column10: iFlytek trains on home-made chips only; this sentence gives no reason for "只能". DeepSeek named as training on Nvidia H800 cards.

column3: Investor relations activity record (filed on cninfo)
column7: 美国政府极大概率会对我国的英伟达算力获取和国产算力海外投片采取更严苛的限制措施
column10: Expects further US restriction of China's access to Nvidia compute; names the US government only.

column3: Results meeting, activity record (filed on cninfo)
column5: (record lists chairman Liu Qingfeng, president Wu Xiaoru, board secretary Jiang Tao and others)
column7: 科大讯飞 2019 年被美国政府纳入实体清单，2022 年又被极限施压，在面对美国政府制裁的过程中核心技术研究和产品开发平台已逐步实现全面自主可控 || 美国出台多轮政策打压中国的科技企业并限制先进制程 AI 芯片对华出口，最新一轮已经限制销售英伟达 H20 芯片 || 科大讯飞多年来在国产算力生态上持续投入，我们今天在国产自主可控上的额外付出，都必将会成为科大讯飞在人工智能发展中的比较优势
column10: The pressure named is America's: the Entity List and the US curb on H20 sales. No Chinese authority is named as restricting purchases.

column3: Results meeting, activity record (filed on cninfo)
column7: 如果国外高端算力芯片对我国彻底断供，其他厂商基于英伟达算力的优势就无法持续
column10: Says other Chinese model makers' advantage rested on Nvidia compute: they used, and drew an edge from, Nvidia chips.

column3: Results meeting, activity record (filed on cninfo)
column7: 在国家大力推动人工智能自主可控算力建设的战略背景下 || 随着国家对人工智能自主可控的支持不断到位
column10: A company's description of state policy as pushing self-reliant compute and supporting it; names no rule and no share.

column3: Half-year results meeting, activity record (filed on cninfo)
column5: (record lists Liu Qingfeng, Wu Xiaoru, Jiang Tao and others)
column7: 尽管纯国产化算力相比使用英伟达算力，需要增加移植适配、性能调优、对比验证等额外步骤和额外算力，基于国产算力的新算法研发，会慢一些，但不会矮
column10: Home-made compute costs extra steps and extra compute compared with Nvidia: a reason buyers would prefer Nvidia.

column3: Results meeting, activity record (filed on cninfo)
column5: (record lists Liu Qingfeng, Wu Xiaoru, Jiang Tao, research head Liu Cong and others)
column7: 但由于昇腾 910B 芯片的硬件设计限制，包括显存容量显著低于 H200 芯片（64G Vs 141G），显著带宽差 2 倍（1.6 TB/s Vs 4.8TB/s ）等 || 这些限制导致在新模型训练过程中遇到很大的困难 || 但即便如此我们也坚持在全国产算力上持续探索和突破
column10: Huawei's 910B behind Nvidia's H200 on memory and bandwidth, causing great difficulty in training; iFlytek keeps to home-made chips anyway.

column3: Results meeting, activity record (filed on cninfo)
column7: 包括近期有一些媒体在报道 DeepSeek V4 是国产昇腾算力上训练的，但实际只是基于昇腾算力对 V4 模型做了推理适配，DS V4 的训练仍然是基于英伟达卡进行的
column10: A competitor's claim about DeepSeek V4 (trained on Nvidia cards, only adapted to Ascend for inference); not DeepSeek's own statement and not checked here.

column3: Half-year results meeting, activity record (filed on cninfo)
column5: (record lists chairman Liu Qingfeng, president Wu Xiaoru, board secretary Jiang Tao, finance director Cai Shang)
column7: 近两年讯飞面临的一个比较大的压力，来自其他模型厂商普遍使用性能领先两代的英伟达芯片，其生态更完善，各类算法的训练与移植效率更高
column10: Other Chinese model makers "commonly use" Nvidia chips two generations ahead, with a better ecosystem: they preferred and had Nvidia chips (also bears on limit 3: chips came in).

column3: Half-year results meeting, activity record (filed on cninfo)
column7: 随着美国对顶尖芯片出口管制越来越严格，未来两年内国内同行同样很难再采购到英伟达高端芯片，全行业都会被倒逼转向国产算力，国产算力的生态将得到极大完善
column10: The force named for the coming switch is US export controls, not Beijing.

column3: Half-year results meeting, activity record (filed on cninfo)
column7: 同时，国家层面举国体制优势亦为公司提供算力支持 || 公司承担重要战略任务，国家亦将在现有及未来算力资源上持续给予支持
column10: The state supplies computing power to iFlytek; the record does not say which chips.

column3: Half-year results meeting, activity record (filed on cninfo)
column7: 尤其是在讯飞被列入美国实体清单的背景下，更需要在全栈自主可控的国产芯片及配套硬件元器件供应上做好保障 || 面对客户算力设备来源多元的客观现实——华为、海光、寒武纪乃至英伟达并存
column10: iFlytek's own supply rests on home-made chips because of the US Entity List; its customers run Huawei, Hygon, Cambricon and Nvidia side by side.

column3: Half-year results meeting, activity record (filed on cninfo)
column7: 主要算力集群在采样推理效率上与 H200 相比确实存在约五倍的差距 || 目前华为 950DT 对标 H200，根据不同任务，综合性能已达其 65%-85%
column10: The gap to the H200 as iFlytek measures it, and Huawei's 950DT closing it.

column3: Answer on the investor-question platform irm.cninfo.com.cn (question of 2026-08-14)
column5: (the platform record gives the company only; no person named)
column7: 近两年讯飞在算力方面面临较大压力，来自其他模型厂商普遍使用性能领先两代的英伟达芯片 || 同时，国家层面举国体制优势亦为公司提供算力支持
column10: Close to the words of the Aug 21 record (there: 近两年讯飞面临的一个比较大的压力), given in writing to an investor; dates from the record's questionDate and replyDate (the id's date is not the answer date).

column3: Half-year report 2026 (filed on cninfo)
column7: 但是国产算力由于硬件设计限制对比英伟达中端芯片 H200 尚存在明显差距
column10: The filed report itself states the gap to Nvidia's "mid-range" H200. Board approval Aug 19, 2026 (the report's own text); published on cninfo Aug 21, 2026 (cninfo's query).

column3: Annual report 2024 (filed on cninfo)
column7: 科大讯飞两次被列入美国实体清单并且成功应对极限施压
column10: Repeated in the 2025 annual report and the 2026 half-year report: iFlytek is on the US Entity List, so it cannot be a would-be Nvidia buyer in the ordinary way.

column3: Q3 results meeting, activity record (filed on cninfo)
column5: Vice president, board secretary (the only company attendee listed)
column7: 对于 4B 级别端侧模型和约 3,000 亿参数的中等规模模型训练，公司目前拥有的算力是充足的 || 华为 950 算力正在 陆续到位
column10: Compute sufficient for the sizes it now trains; Huawei 950 supply arriving.

column3: Annual results announcement 2024 (English; todayir host)
column7: In terms of domestic chips, we have realized large-scale commercial deployment of domestic clusters, which included domestic chips such as Ascend, Hygon, Cambricon, MetaX, Biren, etc. || These breakthroughs enabled us to flexibly combine chip resources from different manufacturers, enhancing the resiliency of the supply chain.
column10: The company's own stated reason for home-made clusters is supply-chain resilience; no state guidance named.

column3: Interim results announcement 2025 (English; todayir host)
column7: The AI GPU chip company has been deconsolidated since the start of the year || SenseCore achieved stable operation of roughly 5,000-chip heterogeneous cluster of domestic chips || while continuously optimizing GPU mix in line with technology trends
column10: Home-made clusters in operation; "GPU mix" managed "in line with technology trends"; no maker named.

column3: Annual results announcement 2025 (English; todayir host)
column7: We partnered with over a dozen of chip suppliers including Huawei Ascend, Hygon and Cambricon to launch the “SenseCore Computing Power Mall” || launching China’s first overseas domestic computing cluster in Saudi Arabia || expanding its AI infrastructure (SenseCore) with increased adoption of domestic chips
column10: The company itself markets home-made compute, abroad too, and spends placing money on domestic chips. Its last passage also stands in the annual report 2025 (tables/labs_said.tsv, 2026-04-27, cn-le29-sensetime-2025-annual-en-tcurl): two documents a month apart, two rows by the tables' rule; a count of separate remarks should know it.

column7: 大裝置結合先進算力的互聯和顯存特點 || 通過訓練與採樣（Rollout）任務解耦，並利用國產算力與先進算力異構推理資源加速樣本生成
column10: SenseTime uses "advanced compute" beside home-made compute for long-context training and sampling; the page does not say whose chips "先進算力" are.

column3: Interim results announcement 2026 (Chinese; Eastmoney mirror)
column7: 公司堅定推動國產算力生態建設 || SenseNova U1開源模型與十餘家國產芯片廠商實現Day 0（首日）適配 || 重點為擴展由國產芯片賦能的國產人工智能超算集群
column10: Own commitment to home-made compute; 40% of the net proceeds of the April 2026 placing are for enlarging its AI infrastructure (SenseCore), with the focus on supercomputing clusters on home-made chips. Replaces the Ifeng relay of tables/labs_said.tsv with the filing itself; the relay is still a row of tables/labs_said.tsv (2026-08-26, cn-le09-ifeng-sensetime-8vuf8), so a count over both tables takes this remark once.

column3: Eight results announcements and reports (2024 annual results and report, 2025 interim results and report, 2025 annual results and report, 2026 interim results and report)
column7: Powered by NVIDIA’s cutting-edge Thor computing platform
column10: Silence: none of the eight mentions US export controls, the Entity List, Nvidia's China chips or any state guidance. Control: the same count finds Nvidia (this Thor line; 英偉達 once in the 2024 Chinese texts) and home-made chips in every one.

column3: Written answer on the investor-question platform irm.cninfo.com.cn (question of Sep 10, 2026)
column7: 总体来说，公司不会在参数规模上与头部海外模型“摸高”竞赛，而是算清产业层面的经济账，打赢落地战，形成更可持续的利润与现金流，待国产算力不断进化，逐渐拉平差距后，届时再考虑参与那些追求极致参数规模的长程任务。
column10: Home-made compute still has a gap to close before iFlytek trains at the largest scale. Caution: iFlytek is on the US Entity List, so it is not a buyer Beijing turned away from Nvidia. Dates are the record's questionDate and replyDate fields.

column3: Written answer on the platform (question of Sep 16, 2026)
column7: 9 月 7 日，星火 X2.5 正式发布，该模型基于全国产算力完成全流程训练
column10: Trained wholly on home-made compute (an Entity-List company).

column7: 2026 年 4 月，公司发布了完全基于全国产算力训练和推理的中等尺寸模型 || 同时与国产算力厂商在高效模型结构等方向深化联合攻关
column10: As above.

column3: Written answer on the platform (question of Aug 11, 2026)
column7: 其中部分增长来自算力投入增加 || 涵盖自建算力折旧摊销与租赁支出
column10: Spending on compute it builds and leases; no origin named.

column3: Interim results 2026, as 每日经济新闻 reports it
column6: press report of words on the record
column7: 主流国产芯片经过优化后， MFU 即模型浮点运算利用率最高可达到芯片原厂基准水平的 2.5 倍
column10: Home-made chips made to run better by its own software; no import or policy words in the report.

column3: Revised proposal for a share issue to specific investors (filed on cninfo, Sept 30, 2025); the same passage in the prospectus of Feb 2026 (cn-ga31-localrulep3-21)
column7: 仍然高度依赖英伟达生态，基于全国产算力开展算法适配优化和算法创新还面临诸多挑战 || 由于国产算力硬件性能不足和软件算子缺失 || 大模型训练任务性能达到同规模英伟达 A800 集群的 90%以上 || 在国家政策的支持下相对行业具有显著的成本优势
column10: iFlytek says industry work on larger models, MoE and long-chain reasoning still relies heavily on Nvidia's ecosystem. It reports that the domestic computing cluster it launched with Huawei reached at least 90% of the performance of an Nvidia A800 cluster of the same size on large-model training tasks. It says its proposed policy-backed compute lease has a cost advantage over other model developers’ self-built clusters. "二〇二五年九月" is on the proposal and "二〇二六年二月" is on the prospectus.
